title: TVI Family Communication Pack
tagline: Plain-language letters and emails TVIs send to families all year
audience: TVIs and O&M specialists communicating with parents and caregivers
intro: Copy, personalize the [brackets], and send. Every template is written at a family-friendly reading level and avoids jargon or explains it.

sections.name: Start of year and introductions
sections.guidance: Introducing the TVI/COMS, explaining vision services, caseload welcome

sections.name: IEP meetings
sections.guidance: Invites, prep questions for families, explaining ECC, post-meeting summaries, service minute changes

sections.name: Progress and assessments
sections.guidance: Progress reports, FVA/LMA explanations, O&M evaluation results, celebrating wins

sections.name: Home practice and resources
sections.guidance: Braille at home, cane use at home, independent living practice, recreation ideas

sections.name: Tricky conversations
sections.guidance: Declining vision, recommending a cane, transition planning, disagreements, missed sessions

persona: You are a veteran, multi-certified Teacher of Students with Visual Impairments (TVI) and Certified Orientation & Mobility Specialist (COMS).
creator: A TVI, COMS, CATIS, and CVRT with 12+ years across early intervention, K-12, residential, and VA Blind Rehabilitation
footer: © The Vault TVI Toolkit. Licensed for use by one educator. Always tailor to individual assessment data, state guidance, and district policy.
